deadline.value: Apply by April 1, 2027 (the Faculty of Graduate Studies deadline for non-Canadian applicants for September entry; the department sets no earlier date).
deadline.quote: For September admission: | June 1 (Canadian applicants), April 1 (non-Canadian applicants)

also.quote: Many departments have their own deadlines, which can be much earlier than the above deadlines.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the department's pages.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required, though the department appreciates receiving them.
gre_general.quote: Are GRE scores required/mandatory for my application? | No, but we do appreciate receiving them

supervisor.value: An application is only complete once a supervisor has agreed to support your studies and funding; without one it is usually rejected.
supervisor.quote: A supervisor has agreed to support your studies and funding | Applicants who apply without a supervisor in place may sometimes have their application accepted if a supervisor can be found, but more frequently their application is rejected for lack of a

funding.value: Every accepted PhD student is guaranteed a minimum stipend after tuition and fees for four years; nobody is accepted without funding.
funding.quote: A student will not be accepted unless funding is assured. | Every graduate student who is accepted into either a MSc (two-year) or PhD (four-year) program in the Department of Biology is guaranteed a minimum stipend after tuition and other fees.

entry_route.value: Without a graduate degree you must apply to the MSc and can transfer to the PhD at the candidacy exam after 4-8 months.
entry_route.quote: If you do not already have a graduate degree you must apply to the MSc program. | At your Admission to Candidacy exam, which occurs after four to eight months in the program, you may apply to transfer to the PhD program.

notes: Students are rarely admitted without an honours degree.
